material_news_signals.headline: NFL Week 2 Sunday aftermath: Surprising Raiders, soaring Chiefs and sinking Chargers in spotlight
material_news_signals.description: How surprising is the Raiders' 2-0 start? Are Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs truly BACK? Can anyone handle Brian Flores' blitz-happy defense? NFL.com senior news writer Kevin Patra digs into the top storylines coming out of Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the league wide average of 40 9 points per tilt in week 2 is down significantly from week 1 s mark of 49 4 ppg with monday night football remaining five defenses held their opponents without a touchdown on sunday carolina chicago cincinnati minnesota and new england it s notable that two of those teams the bears and panthers were involved in a 96 point week 1 bout the week to week flip underscores that clubs are still figuring themselves out early in the 2026 campaign two high profile quarterback injuries jayden daniels dislocated left elbow and caleb williams hamstring will hover over the early portion of the week as we wait to better understand the extent of those players potential absences let s look at the rest of the aftermath of sunday s showdowns including chiefs prove they re back with ot victory vikings d dominates in gritty win at chicago cowboys get back on track as dak passes romo concern brewing for these four offenses one defender who stuffed the stat sheet in week 2 but first a look at some unexpected developments in the young season raiders lead surprising 2 0 teams if we were ranking the most stunning teams to begin this season at 2 0 we d start with the las vegas raiders then there would be a wide football field long gap before the next squad klint kubiak and co took care of business in the opener against a miami team they were supposed to beat they were expected to be a doormat in l a in week 2 nope instead the raiders sent the chargers spiraling with a 26 14 win outplaying their opponents in all three facets that isn t something we ve been able to say about the silver and black in a long long time it s not just that vegas won its first two games it s that the raiders are winning by being the more professional team in years past the raiders have bungled themselves into the turf they were the ones turning the ball over in key spots making mental mistakes and taking brutal drive killing penalties sunday they were the even keeled squad letting the chargers dunk on themselves vegas capitalized at every turn kirk cousins is far from perfect but the 38 year old can still sling it on throws of 10 plus air yards against the bolts cousins was 8 of 12 for 181 yards three touchdowns and one interception per nfl research the 40 yard touchdown pass to tre tucker was just the third completed pass of 40 plus air yards by a raiders qb over the past three seasons kubiak has modernized the offense while rob leonard s defense has swarmed forcing five turnovers over two games the raiders had 16 takeaways all of last year soberly i anticipate the positive vibes from the raiders first 2 0 start since 2021 to be curtailed particularly as the schedule picks up in october however the building blocks of the future are more visible than at any time in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through two weeks with the big boys creating havoc and taking up blockers demetrius knight and barrett carter have played more fluidly sure the young lbs still have some coverage issues but their performance has improved significantly on sunday the bengals did not allow a single touchdown their first game allowing zero tds since a 27 12 road win over the jets back in week 3 of 2022 per nfl research of course there was still the joe burrow ja 39 marr chase magic to put cincy over the top but this was a game the bengals lose with last year s defense while we re here this is how i d rank the eight 2 0 teams with the giants looking to join the list by beating the rams on monday night starting with the most impressive through two weeks buffalo bills san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks kansas city chiefs minnesota vikings cincinnati bengals las vegas raiders philadelphia eagles chiefs mahomes prove they are back trailing the colts in the third quarter and facing a third and 11 patrick mahomes uncorked a 45 yard bomb to tyquan thornton to put the chiefs on the doorstep of a go ahead touchdown the heave underscored that a mahomes is fully back and b the chiefs offense can finally return to being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the fourth quarter that blitz rate would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 per ngs flores ability to create havoc without confusing his own players or giving up a trove of big plays on the back end is impressive other teams could try it and get repeatedly burned for flores it s a style it s doubly remarkable given the questions minnesota entered the season with on the back end isaiah rodgers has been studly so far and the return of veteran safety harrison smith has been a godsend dallas turner has come on strong in year 3 the former first round pick generated 10 pressures including two sacks on 36 pass rushes against the bears marking his second straight week with double digit pressures per ngs five of the pressures on sunday were unblocked a credit to flores discombobulating the offense as minnesota s offense continues to figure things out flores defense has the muscle and guts to keep the vikes on the winning track boys back on track after dak s record day after the prime time week 1 dud in new york dallas showed its high octane potential in an easy home win over the commanders with dak prescott tossing four touchdown strikes to break tony romo s all time franchise record of 248 passing tds it s quite impressive for a former fourth rounder to put himself in a spot not only to break records but to sprint past them sometimes it s great being naive and i was a little naive just growing up thinking that i could do this and i could do that but yet i think it put such insurmountable belief in my head that i can accomplish whatever i want to accomplish prescott said after the game and any thought that i said or anything that i wanted to do and i mentioned it and i said it out loud i had a mom and i had brothers who poured gas on those thoughts who told me i could and as i said you can call it arrogance you can call it confidence belief whatever you need to i wouldn t be here if i didn t have those thoughts if i didn t believe in myself like that and i just encourage the next little kid out there who comes from the trailer park in louisiana or wherever he may come from and doesn t know if he can do it or have the resources or have the family that you re right believe in what you want to believe in and find the people that support that and you can do it the cowboys continue to have issues with their revamped defense under christian parker the injuries aren t helping but dallas had far too many breakdowns against washington especially early some of the issues are of the mental variety and can be cleaned up sunday was reminiscent of 2025 when the cowboys needed big offensive performances to earn ws fortunately for brian schottenheimer when dak spins it like he did against the commanders few defenses can keep him quiet the hope is that eventually the defense catches up are these four offenses in trouble week 2 sunday spotlight

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Network: Giants' Jaxson Dart potentially out for season after testing shows worse knee injury
material_news_signals.description: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart could miss the rest of the season after Tuesday testing showed his knee injury is worse than initially feared, NFL Network Insiders Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
material_news_signals.body_text: jaxson dart s 2026 season is in jeopardy the new york giants starting quarterback could potentially miss the rest of the season after testing on tuesday showed his knee injury is worse than initially feared nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported schefter added dart could undergo season ending surgery right now evaluations are ongoing we haven t gotten any final decisions yet giants head coach john harbaugh said on tuesday minutes after the report broke we ve learned a lot more i wouldn t really want to share too much until decisions get made and that takes more than one person it takes everybody involved when we know what direction we re going to have to go we ll announce that but we don t have that yet so i don t want to get out over our skis on that can t really respond to every report that people make got to work on our own timeline here harbaugh was asked specifically about the report dart could miss the rest of the season i don t think i can really comment on any of that right now until we know for sure what s going to transpire he said dart suffered the injury which reportedly was initially believed to be a sprained mcl at the end of the giants first possession in their 28 6 loss to the rams on monday night jameis winston replaced dart completing 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards and an interception dart walked off the field under his own power and was taken into the locker room for further evaluation monday night which initially produced results that were encouraging enough for dart to attempt to re enter the game espn s laura rutledge reported during the broadcast harbaugh echoed the optimistic sentiment afterward telling reporters on monday that it appeared dart avoided the devastating outcome and landed in the neighborhood of an mcl sprain adding new york would know more after a tuesday mri tuesday wasn t as positive and now the giants might have to confront a reality they d hoped to avoid dart s knee injury marks the second instance in which he s been sidelined due to health challenges he missed two games in 2025 due to a concussion and has attracted attention for his fearless style of play which has left him susceptible to more hits than the average quarterback the hit that caused the injury on monday night however occurred with dart under duress in the pocket and had nothing to do with his scrambling aggression unfortunately the outcome is too familiar to the giants who must shift toward preparing winston as their starter for the foreseeable future winston started two games in place of dart in 2025 going 0 2 in one score losses to green bay and detroit new york felt confident enough about winston s capabilities as a veteran backup to reward the 2015 no 1 overall pick with a two year 13 million extension earlier this month locking down a trusted second option behind dart he ll have a chance to prove the giants weren t misguided in their faith when new york hosts the tennessee titans 0 2 on sunday

material_news_signals.description: Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford tossed four touchdown passes, including two to receiver Davante Adams, in Los Angeles' blowout Monday night win over the Giants.
material_news_signals.body_text: aaron donald returned to the field on monday night and so did the los angeles rams offense which was absent in week 1 the two felt intertwined in the 28 6 blowout victory over the new york giants at sofi stadium monday marked donald s first game back since he retired after the 2023 season i was so juiced he came running out of the tunnel and i couldn t control myself matthew stafford said of donald s return i was freaking fired up i m sure y all were in there the fans were happy to see him back and we all were too just the human being the player all of it combined what he brings to our team and to our locker room is unmatched and really to the city which i thought was amazing i thought it was a great reception for him tonight well deserved the juiced stafford went out and ripped apart the banged up giants secondary whipping four touchdowns on 22 of 31 passes for 327 yards new york pressured stafford on just 15 2 of his dropbacks the fourth lowest rate he has faced in a game as a ram since 2021 per next gen stats when kept clean he completed 20 of 27 attempts for 302 yards including all four touchdowns and his lone interception which was a heat check deep shot in the second quarter despite not having all pro receiver puka nacua stafford moved the ball at will feeding davante adams the reigning mvp hit adams with 8 passes for 195 yards and two tds the rest of the rams offense combined for 132 receiving yards he s wide receiver one to me he ain t a two head coach sean mcvay said of adams he was special and it showed all night that s what he s consistently done and i m really happy for him i thought he made some great plays but you could see there s a lot of trust that he and matthew have they were able to get a lot of work together this offseason and it s only going to continue to build i was really happy for him he did his thing tonight according to opta stats the most yards by a qb receiver duo 33 or older in a game in nfl history is 289 by steve young and jerry rice on dec 18 1995 stafford and adams came in no 2 on monday with 195 a week after struggling to move the ball consistently against the 49ers in australia the rams moved unimpeded through the big blue defense gobbling up 481 yards and 23 first downs they converted 5 of 9 third downs and went 3 of 3 in the red zone outside of two turnovers in the second quarter l a did whatever it wanted with donald returning the rams d played with a little more fire and rattled backup quarterback jameis winston who was thrust into action after jaxson dart s first drive injury playing a more physical brand of defense than a week ago l a gave up just 182 total yards 11 first downs and two field goals donald noted that the speed of the game didn t feel like too much after two years off the game really wasn t as fast as i thought he said it was more of me calming myself down overrunning stuff or just my feet not being in the ground how they supposed to be not trusting my eyes little stuff like that but playing the game when i held out in 17 18 it was the same way when i came back it took a couple games to get going it s a little different i ain t played in two years so i gotta watch the film see what i did good see what i did wrong and just clean it up in his return donald had three tackles including one for loss and one quarterback pressure on 18 pass rushes tied for his career low per next gen stats after last week s dismal performance against san francisco the rams got back on track at home mcvay even took a shot at himself for the australia travel plans which were roundly panned after the blowout loss sometimes you win sometimes you learn he said sometimes you have a dumbass coach that makes travel plans that put you in a bad spot so there you go that s a dropped mic
